name: com.nonatomic.servicekit
description: A lightweight dependency injection and service locator framework for Unity. Attribute-based registration, async resolution, fluent API, optional dependencies, service tags, scene-aware lifecycle, and UniTask support.

samples.description: Introduction to ServiceKit - creating locators, registering services, and consuming them.
Using ServiceKitBehaviour base class for MonoBehaviour-based services with automatic lifecycle management.
The fluent API for clean, chainable service registration.
Registering a single service instance under multiple interface types.
Intelligent 3-state dependency resolution for optional services.
Organizing and filtering services using tags.
Asynchronous service resolution with timeout and cancellation support.
Managing service lifecycle across scene transitions.
A mini-game demonstrating real-world ServiceKit usage patterns.
Testing ServiceKitBehaviour services with mocks and real locators using UseLocator().
TryResolveService, timeout recovery, circular dependency exemption, and custom error handlers.
